title: Signage for designated science and living spaces

title: Trip hazard coloring

title: Hazard warning signage

title: Accessibility of food and beverage service areas

source.quote: Food and beverage service areas should be accessible

title: Tactile stripping for obstructions or steps on weather decks

applies_to.condition_text: to alert of obstructions or steps

source.quote: Tactile stripping to alert of obstructions or steps

title: Audible signals and induction mechanisms on weather deck hatchways

source.quote: Audible signals and induction mechanisms should be installed on hatchways

title: Designated mobility impaired stateroom in Global Class vessels

applies_to.condition_text: all new Global Class research vessel construction

source.quote: One designated Stateroom for personnel with mobility impairments should be incorporated in all new Global Class research vessel construction.

title: Personnel rated elevator access to scientific spaces

applies_to.condition_text: to allow access to scientific spaces on all decks

source.quote: A personnel rated elevator should also be included to allow access to scientific spaces on all decks.

title: Emergency wiring for hearing and vision impairments

source.quote: Staterooms equipped with wiring to accept portable kits to accommodate hearing and vision impairments that go beyond bells and claxons.

title: Rail restraints for berths

source.quote: Provide rail restraints for berths

title: Tactile strips in passageways

applies_to.condition_text: to alert for obstructions and/or steps

source.quote: Tactile strips installed to alert for obstructions and/or steps

title: Public restroom provision per accessible deck

applies_to.condition_text: near to main laboratory

source.quote: Public Restrooms (RV604 toRV606) – One on each accessible deck and near to main laboratory

title: Drinking fountain provision per accessible deck

applies_to.condition_text: If you provide a drinking fountain

source.quote: Drinking Fountains (RV602) - If you provide a drinking fountain, one on each accessible deck

title: Accessible table in mess deck

applies_to.condition_text: with clear access and away from heavy traffic patterns

source.quote: One table with clear access and away from heavy traffic patterns

title: Accessible living and dining areas

source.quote: Living and dining areas shall be accessible.

title: Clear deck space on both sides of a bed

applies_to.condition_text: At least one sleeping area shall provide a clear deck space complying with RV305 on both sides of a bed.

source.quote: At least one sleeping area shall provide a clear deck space complying with RV305 on both sides of a bed.

title: Accessible water closet minimum count in stateroom

source.quote: No fewer than one water closet, one lavatory, and one bathtub or shower shall comply with RV603.

title: Accessible lavatory minimum count in stateroom

source.quote: No fewer than one water closet, one lavatory, and one bathtub or shower shall comply with RV603.

title: Accessible bathtub or shower minimum count in stateroom

source.quote: No fewer than one water closet, one lavatory, and one bathtub or shower shall comply with RV603.

title: Guest room turning space

source.quote: Turning space complying with RV304 shall be provided within the guest room.

title: Emergency alarms in staterooms

applies_to.condition_text: Where emergency warning systems are provided

source.quote: Where emergency warning systems are provided, alarms complying with RV702 shall be provided.

title: Water closet minimum distance from side wall

source.quote: The centerline of the water closet shall be 16 inches (405 mm) minimum to 18 inches (455 mm) maximum from the side wall or partition, except that the water closet shall be 17 inches (430 mm) minimum and 19 inches (485 mm) maximum from the side wall or partition in the ambulatory accessible toilet compartment specified in RV604.8.2.

title: Water closet clearance measured perpendicular from side wall

source.quote: Clearance around a water closet shall be 60 inches (1525 mm) minimum measured perpendicular from the side wall and 56 inches (1420 mm) minimum measured perpendicular from the rear wall.

title: Water closet clearance measured perpendicular from rear wall

source.quote: Clearance around a water closet shall be 60 inches (1525 mm) minimum measured perpendicular from the side wall and 56 inches (1420 mm) minimum measured perpendicular from the rear wall.

title: Obstructions within water closet clearance

source.quote: No other fixtures or obstructions shall be located within the required water closet clearance.

title: Water Closet Seat Height - Minimum

source.quote: The seat height of a water closet above the finish deck surface shall be 17 inches (430 mm) minimum and 19 inches (485 mm) maximum measured to the top of the seat.

title: Water Closet Seat Sprung Return Prohibition

source.quote: Seats shall not be sprung to return to a lifted position.

title: Water Closet Grab Bars Provision

source.quote: Grab bars shall be provided on the side wall closest to the water closet and on the rear wall.

title: Side Wall Grab Bar Length

source.quote: The side wall grab bar shall be 42 inches (1065 mm) long minimum, located 12 inches (305 mm) maximum from the rear wall and extending 54 inches (1370 mm) minimum from the rear wall.

title: Side Wall Grab Bar Location from Rear Wall

source.quote: located 12 inches (305 mm) maximum from the rear wall and extending 54 inches (1370 mm) minimum from the rear wall.

title: Side Wall Grab Bar Extension from Rear Wall

source.quote: extending 54 inches (1370 mm) minimum from the rear wall.

title: Rear Wall Grab Bar Length

source.quote: The rear wall grab bar shall be 36 inches (915 mm) long minimum and extend from the centerline of the water closet 12 inches (305 mm) minimum on one side and 24 inches (610 mm) minimum on the other side.

title: Rear Wall Grab Bar Extension - First Side

source.quote: extend from the centerline of the water closet 12 inches (305 mm) minimum on one side and 24 inches (610 mm) minimum on the other side.

title: Flush Controls Location

applies_to.condition_text: except in ambulatory accessible compartments complying with RV604.8.2

source.quote: Flush controls shall be located on the open side of the water closet except in ambulatory accessible compartments complying with RV604.8.2.

title: Toilet Paper Dispenser Position in Front of Water Closet - Minimum

source.quote: Toilet paper dispensers shall comply with RV309.4 and shall be 7 inches (180 mm) minimum and 9 inches (230 mm) maximum in front of the water closet measured to the centerline of the dispenser.

title: Toilet Paper Dispenser Outlet Height - Minimum

source.quote: The outlet of the dispenser shall be 15 inches (380 mm) minimum and 48 inches (1220 mm) maximum above the finish deck surface and shall not be located behind grab bars.

title: Toilet Paper Dispenser Location Relative to Grab Bars

source.quote: shall not be located behind grab bars.

title: Wheelchair Accessible Toilet Compartment Width

source.quote: Wheelchair accessible compartments shall be 60 inches (1525 mm) wide minimum measured perpendicular to the side wall, and 56 inches (1420 mm) deep minimum for wall hung water closets, and 59 inches (1500 mm) deep minimum for deck surface mounted water closets measured perpendicular to the rear wall.

title: Wheelchair Accessible Toilet Compartment Depth - Wall Hung Water Closet

applies_to.condition_text: for wall hung water closets

source.quote: and 56 inches (1420 mm) deep minimum for wall hung water closets

title: Lavatory and Sink Counter or Rim Height

source.quote: Lavatories and sinks shall be installed with the front of the higher of the rim or counter surface 34 inches (865 mm) maximum above the finish deck surface.

title: Metering Faucet Open Duration

source.quote: Hand-operated, metering faucets shall remain open for 10 seconds minimum.

title: Exposed Pipes Protection Under Lavatories and Sinks

applies_to.condition_text: under lavatories and sinks

source.quote: Water supply and drain pipes under lavatories and sinks shall be insulated or otherwise configured to protect against contact.

title: Surfaces Under Lavatories and Sinks

applies_to.condition_text: under lavatories and sinks

source.quote: There shall be no sharp or abrasive surfaces under lavatories and sinks.

title: Grab Bars Above Seat Prohibition

applies_to.condition_text: above the seat

source.quote: Grab bars shall not be provided above the seat.

title: Standard Roll-In Shower Grab Bars on Three Walls

applies_to.condition_text: Where a seat is not provided in standard roll-in type shower compartments

source.quote: Where a seat is not provided in standard roll-in type shower compartments, grab bars shall be provided on three walls.

title: Shower Compartment Grab Bar Maximum Distance from Adjacent Walls

source.quote: Grab bars shall be installed 6 inches (150 mm) maximum from adjacent walls.

title: Vertical Grab Bar on Post-Mounted Shower Head

applies_to.condition_text: Where the shower head is mounted on a post

source.quote: Where the shower head is mounted on a post, a vertical grab shall be provided under the shower head.

title: Vertical Grab Bar Proximity to Shower Head

applies_to.condition_text: Where the shower head is mounted on a post

source.quote: The grab bar shall start at a point at or below the minimum grab bar mounting height in RV609 and shall extend to within at least 3 inches (75 mm) of the shower head.

title: Circular Grab Bar on Post-Mounted Shower Head

applies_to.condition_text: Where the shower head is mounted on a post

source.quote: Where the shower head is mounted on a post, a circular grab bar that surrounds the usable part of the post shall be provided.

title: Horizontal Grab Bar Extension from Shower Head

applies_to.condition_text: Where the shower head is mounted on a post or a wall

source.quote: Where the shower head is mounted on a post or a wall, a horizontal grab bar extending 18 inches (455 mm) minimum in both directions from the center line of the shower head shall be provided.

title: Standard Roll-In Shower Controls Maximum Height

applies_to.condition_text: In standard roll-in type shower compartments

source.quote: In standard roll-in type shower compartments, the controls, faucets, and shower spray unit shall be located above the grab bar, but no higher than 48 inches (1220 mm) above the shower deck surface.

title: Standard Roll-In Shower Controls Distance from Seat Wall

applies_to.condition_text: Where a seat is provided

source.quote: Where a seat is provided, the controls, faucets, and shower spray unit shall be installed on the back wall adjacent to the seat wall and shall be located 27 inches (685 mm) maximum from the seat wall.

title: Shower Spray Unit Hose Minimum Length

source.quote: A shower spray unit with a hose 59 inches (1500 mm) long minimum that can be used both as a fixed-position shower head and as a hand-held shower shall be provided.

title: Shower Spray Unit Non-Positive Shut-Off

source.quote: The shower spray unit shall have an on/off control with a non-positive shut-off.

title: Adjustable-Height Shower Head Obstruction of Grab Bars

applies_to.condition_text: If an adjustable-height shower head on a vertical bar is used

source.quote: If an adjustable-height shower head on a vertical bar is used, the bar shall be installed so as not to obstruct the use of grab bars.

title: Shower Spray Unit Maximum Water Temperature

source.quote: Shower spray units shall deliver water that is 120°F (49°C) maximum.

title: Circular Grab Bar Minimum Outside Diameter

applies_to.condition_text: Grab bars with circular cross sections

source.quote: Grab bars with circular cross sections shall have an outside diameter of 1¼ inches (32 mm) minimum and 2 inches (51 mm) maximum.

title: Grab Bar Wall Clearance

source.quote: The space between the wall and the grab bar shall be 1½ inches (38 mm).

title: Grab Bar Post Clearance at Rinsing Showers

applies_to.condition_text: At rinsing showers, if grab bars are installed on posts

source.quote: At rinsing showers, if grab bars are installed on posts, the space between the post and grab bar shall be 1½ inches (38 mm).

title: Grab Bar Clearance to Projecting Objects Below and at Ends

source.quote: The space between the grab bar and projecting objects below and at the ends shall be 1½ inches (38 mm) minimum.

title: Grab Bar Clearance to Projecting Objects Above

source.quote: The space between the grab bar and projecting objects above shall be 12 inches (305 mm) minimum.

title: Grab Bar Minimum Mounting Height

source.quote: Grab bars shall be installed in a horizontal position, 33 inches (840 mm) minimum and 36 inches (915 mm) maximum above the finish deck surface measured to the top of the gripping surface

title: Grab Bar Structural Strength

source.quote: Allowable stresses shall not be exceeded for materials used when a vertical or horizontal force of 250 pounds (1112 N) is applied at any point on the grab bar, fastener, mounting device, or supporting structure.

title: Shower Compartment Seat Distance to Entry (Standard Roll-in)

applies_to.condition_text: Where a seat is provided in a standard roll-in shower compartment

source.quote: Where a seat is provided in a standard roll-in shower compartment, it shall be a folding type, shall be installed on the side wall adjacent to the controls, and shall extend from the back wall to a point within 3 inches (75 mm) of the compartment entry.

title: Shower Seat Minimum Height

source.quote: The top of the seat shall be 17 inches (430 mm) minimum and 19 inches (485 mm) maximum above the bathroom finish deck surface.

title: Passageway Minimum Clear Width

source.quote: The clear width of walking surfaces shall be 36 inches (915 mm) minimum.

title: Passageway Protrusion Limits

applies_to.condition_text: Objects with leading edges more than 27 inches (685 mm) and not more than 80 inches (2030 mm) above the finish deck surface

source.quote: Objects with leading edges more than 27 inches (685 mm) and not more than 80 inches (2030 mm) above the finish deck surface shall protrude 4 inches (100 mm) maximum horizontally into the circulation path.

title: Doorway Minimum Clear Width

source.quote: Door openings shall provide a clear width of 32 inches (815 mm) minimum.

title: Water Closet Centerline Minimum Distance from Side Wall

applies_to.condition_text: except that the water closet shall be 17 inches (430 mm) minimum and 19 inches (485 mm) maximum from the side wall or partition in the ambulatory accessible toilet compartment specified in RV604.8.2

source.quote: The centerline of the water closet shall be 16 inches (405 mm) minimum to 18 inches (455 mm) maximum from the side wall or partition, except that the water closet shall be 17 inches (430 mm) minimum and 19 inches (485 mm) maximum from the side wall or partition in the ambulatory accessible toilet compartment specified in RV604.8.2.

title: Water Closet Grab Bars

source.quote: Grab bars shall be provided on the side wall closest to the water closet and on the rear wall.

title: Side wall grab bar maximum distance from rear wall

applies_to.condition_text: side wall grab bar

source.quote: located 12 inches (305 mm) maximum from the rear wall

title: Side wall grab bar minimum extension from rear wall

applies_to.condition_text: side wall grab bar

source.quote: extending 54 inches (1370 mm) minimum from the rear wall.

title: Rear wall grab bar minimum extension from centerline - one side

applies_to.condition_text: rear wall grab bar

source.quote: extend from the centerline of the water closet 12 inches (305 mm) minimum on one side

title: Toilet paper dispenser minimum distance in front of water closet

source.quote: shall be 7 inches (180 mm) minimum and 9 inches (230 mm) maximum in front of the water closet measured to the centerline of the dispenser.

title: Toilet paper dispenser outlet minimum height

source.quote: The outlet of the dispenser shall be 15 inches (380 mm) minimum and 48 inches (1220 mm) maximum above the finish deck surface and shall not be located behind grab bars.

title: Wheelchair accessible compartment minimum width

applies_to.condition_text: Wheelchair accessible compartments

source.quote: Wheelchair accessible compartments shall be 60 inches (1525 mm) wide minimum measured perpendicular to the side wall

title: Wheelchair accessible compartment minimum depth - wall hung water closet

applies_to.condition_text: for wall hung water closets

source.quote: 56 inches (1420 mm) deep minimum for wall hung water closets

title: Prohibition of sharp or abrasive surfaces under lavatories and sinks

applies_to.condition_text: under lavatories and sinks

source.quote: There shall be no sharp or abrasive surfaces under lavatories and sinks.

title: Urinal rim maximum height

applies_to.condition_text: Urinals shall be the stall-type or the wall-hung type

source.quote: Urinals shall be the stall-type or the wall-hung type with the rim 17 inches (430 mm) maximum above the finish deck surface.

title: Urinal minimum depth

source.quote: Urinals shall be 13½ inches (345 mm) deep minimum measured from the outer face of the urinal rim to the back of the fixture.

title: Urinal clear deck space provision

applies_to.condition_text: at urinals

source.quote: A clear deck space complying with RV305 positioned for forward approach shall be provided.

title: Flush Controls Operation

source.quote: Flush controls shall be hand operated or automatic.

title: Drinking Fountain Spout Height

source.quote: Spout outlets shall be 36 inches (915 mm) maximum above the finish deck surface.

title: Drinking Fountain Spout Location - Distance from Vertical Support

source.quote: The spout shall be located 15 inches (380 mm) minimum from the vertical support

title: Drinking Fountain Spout Location - Distance from Front Edge

source.quote: 5 inches (125 mm) maximum from the front edge of the unit, including bumpers.

title: Drinking Fountain Water Flow Height

source.quote: The spout shall provide a flow of water 4 inches (100 mm) high minimum

title: Drinking Fountain Spout Location from Front of Unit

source.quote: shall be located 5 inches (125 mm) maximum from the front of the unit.

title: Water Stream Angle - Spout Located Less Than 3 Inches from Front

applies_to.condition_text: Where spouts are located less than 3 inches (75 mm) of the front of the unit

source.quote: Where spouts are located less than 3 inches (75 mm) of the front of the unit, the angle of the water stream shall be 30 degrees maximum.

title: Drinking Fountains for Standing Persons - Spout Height Minimum

applies_to.condition_text: drinking fountains for standing persons

source.quote: Spout outlets of drinking fountains for standing persons shall be 38 inches (965 mm) minimum and 43 inches (1090 mm) maximum above the finish deck surface.

title: Dining Surfaces and Work Surfaces - Height Minimum

source.quote: The tops of dining surfaces and work surfaces shall be 28 inches (710 mm) minimum and 34 inches (865 mm) maximum above the finish deck surface.

title: Dining and Work Surfaces - Clear Deck Space

source.quote: A clear deck space complying with RV305 positioned for a forward approach shall be provided.

title: Dining and Work Surfaces - Knee Clearance Minimum Height

source.quote: Knee and toe clearance complying with V306 shall be provided, except that knee clearance 24 inches (610 mm) minimum above the finish deck surface shall be permitted.

title: Tables and Counters - Height Minimum

source.quote: The tops of tables and counters shall be 26 inches (660 mm) minimum and 30 inches (760 mm) maximum above the finish deck surface.

title: Bench Clear Deck Space

applies_to.condition_text: positioned at the end of the bench seat and parallel to the short axis of the bench

source.quote: Clear deck space complying with RV305 shall be provided and shall be positioned at the end of the bench seat and parallel to the short axis of the bench.

title: Bench Seat Minimum Length

source.quote: Benches shall have seats that are 42 inches (1065 mm) long minimum and 20 inches (510 mm) deep minimum and 24 inches (610 mm) deep maximum.

title: Bench Seat Minimum Depth

source.quote: Benches shall have seats that are 42 inches (1065 mm) long minimum and 20 inches (510 mm) deep minimum and 24 inches (610 mm) deep maximum.

title: Bench Back Support

source.quote: The bench shall provide for back support or shall be affixed to a wall.

title: Bench Back Support Length

source.quote: Back support shall be 42 inches (1065 mm) long minimum and shall extend from a point 2 inches (51 mm) maximum above the seat surface to a point 18 inches (455 mm) minimum above the seat surface.

title: Bench Back Support Lower Extension

source.quote: Back support shall be 42 inches (1065 mm) long minimum and shall extend from a point 2 inches (51 mm) maximum above the seat surface to a point 18 inches (455 mm) minimum above the seat surface.

title: Bench Back Support Upper Extension

source.quote: Back support shall be 42 inches (1065 mm) long minimum and shall extend from a point 2 inches (51 mm) maximum above the seat surface to a point 18 inches (455 mm) minimum above the seat surface.

title: Bench Back Support Horizontal Clearance from Rear Edge

source.quote: Back support shall be 2½ inches (64 mm) maximum from the rear edge of the seat measured horizontally.

title: Bench Seat Height Minimum

source.quote: The top of the bench seat surface shall be 17 inches (430 mm) minimum and 19 inches (485 mm) maximum above the finish deck surface.

title: Seat - structural strength

source.quote: Allowable stresses shall not be exceeded for materials used when a vertical or horizontal force of 250 pounds (1112 N) is applied at any point on the seat, fastener, mounting device, or supporting structure.

title: Top loading laundry machines - door height

applies_to.condition_text: Top loading machines

source.quote: Top loading machines shall have the door to the laundry compartment located 36 inches (915 mm) maximum above the finish deck surface.

title: Front loading laundry machines - minimum opening height

applies_to.condition_text: Front loading machines

source.quote: Front loading machines shall have the bottom of the opening to the laundry compartment located 15 inches (380 mm) minimum and 36 inches (915 mm) maximum above the finish deck surface.

title: Dining and work surfaces - clear deck space

source.quote: A clear deck space complying with RV305 positioned for a forward approach shall be provided.

title: Dining and work surfaces - knee and toe clearance

source.quote: Knee and toe clearance complying with RV306 shall be provided.

title: Dining and work surfaces - minimum top height

source.quote: The tops of dining surfaces and work surfaces shall be 28 inches (710 mm) minimum and 34 inches (865 mm) maximum above the finish deck surface.

title: Unobstructed high forward reach - maximum height

applies_to.condition_text: Where a forward reach is unobstructed

source.quote: Where a forward reach is unobstructed, the high forward reach shall be 48 inches (1220 mm) maximum and the low forward reach shall be 15 inches (380 mm) minimum above the finish deck surface.

title: Unobstructed low forward reach - minimum height

applies_to.condition_text: Where a forward reach is unobstructed

source.quote: Where a forward reach is unobstructed, the high forward reach shall be 48 inches (1220 mm) maximum and the low forward reach shall be 15 inches (380 mm) minimum above the finish deck surface.

title: Maximum high forward reach over obstruction (reach depth up to 20 inches)

applies_to.condition_text: where the reach depth is 20 inches (510 mm) maximum

source.quote: The high forward reach shall be 48 inches (1220 mm) maximum where the reach depth is 20 inches (510 mm) maximum.

title: Maximum high forward reach over obstruction (reach depth exceeding 20 inches)

applies_to.condition_text: Where the reach depth exceeds 20 inches (510 mm)

source.quote: Where the reach depth exceeds 20 inches (510 mm), the high forward reach shall be 44 inches (1120 mm) maximum and the reach depth shall be 25 inches (635 mm) maximum.

title: Maximum reach depth over obstruction

applies_to.condition_text: Where the reach depth exceeds 20 inches (510 mm)

source.quote: Where the reach depth exceeds 20 inches (510 mm), the high forward reach shall be 44 inches (1120 mm) maximum and the reach depth shall be 25 inches (635 mm) maximum.

title: Maximum high unobstructed side reach

applies_to.condition_text: Where a clear deck space allows a parallel approach to an element and the side reach is unobstructed

source.quote: Where a clear deck space allows a parallel approach to an element and the side reach is unobstructed, the high side reach shall be 48 inches (1220 mm) maximum and the low side reach shall be 15 inches (380 mm) minimum above the finish deck surface.

title: Minimum low unobstructed side reach

applies_to.condition_text: Where a clear deck space allows a parallel approach to an element and the side reach is unobstructed

source.quote: Where a clear deck space allows a parallel approach to an element and the side reach is unobstructed, the high side reach shall be 48 inches (1220 mm) maximum and the low side reach shall be 15 inches (380 mm) minimum above the finish deck surface.

title: Permanently installed audible and visible emergency alarms

source.quote: Emergency alarm systems shall have permanently installed audible and visible alarms complying with NFPA 72 (1999 or 2002 edition) (incorporated by reference, see “Referenced Standards” in Chapter 1)

title: Maximum sound level of audible notification appliances

applies_to.condition_text: at the minimum hearing distance from the audible appliance

source.quote: the maximum allowable sound level of audible notification appliances complying with section 4-3.2.1 of NFPA 72 (1999 edition) shall have a sound level no more than 110 dB at the minimum hearing distance from the audible appliance.

title: Provision of visual and tactile characters on signs

applies_to.condition_text: Where both visual and tactile characters are required

source.quote: Where both visual and tactile characters are required, either one sign with both visual and tactile characters, or two separate signs, one with visual, and one with tactile characters, shall be provided.

title: Raised Characters - Braille Duplication

source.quote: Raised characters shall comply with RV703.2 and shall be duplicated in Braille complying with V703.3.

title: Raised Characters - Minimum Depth

source.quote: Raised characters shall be 1/32 inch (0.8 mm) minimum above their background.

title: Raised Characters - Case

source.quote: Characters shall be uppercase.

title: Raised Characters - Font Style

source.quote: Characters shall be sans serif. Characters shall not be italic, oblique, script, highly decorative, or of other unusual forms.

title: Raised Characters - Minimum Width Proportion

source.quote: Characters shall be selected from fonts where the width of the uppercase letter "O" is 55 percent minimum and 110 percent maximum of the height of the uppercase letter "I".

title: Raised Characters - Minimum Character Height

source.quote: Character height measured vertically from the baseline of the character shall be e inch (16 mm) minimum and 2 inches (51 mm) maximum based on the height of the uppercase letter "I".

title: Raised Characters - Maximum Stroke Thickness

source.quote: Stroke thickness of the uppercase letter "I" shall be 15 percent maximum of the height of the character.

title: Raised Characters (Rectangular Cross Section) - Minimum Spacing

applies_to.condition_text: Where characters have rectangular cross sections

source.quote: Where characters have rectangular cross sections, spacing between individual raised characters shall be 0.13 inch (3.2 mm) minimum and 4 times the raised character stroke width maximum.

title: Raised Characters (Non-Rectangular Cross Section) - Minimum Spacing at Base

applies_to.condition_text: Where characters have other cross sections, at the base of the cross sections

source.quote: Where characters have other cross sections, spacing between individual raised characters shall be 1/16 inch (1.6 mm) minimum and 4 times the raised character stroke width maximum at the base of the cross sections, and 0.13 inch (3.2 mm) minimum and 4 times the raised character stroke width maximum at the top of the cross sections.

title: Raised Characters (Non-Rectangular Cross Section) - Minimum Spacing at Top

applies_to.condition_text: Where characters have other cross sections, at the top of the cross sections

source.quote: Where characters have other cross sections, spacing between individual raised characters shall be 1/16 inch (1.6 mm) minimum and 4 times the raised character stroke width maximum at the base of the cross sections, and 0.13 inch (3.2 mm) minimum and 4 times the raised character stroke width maximum at the top of the cross sections.

title: Raised Characters - Minimum Separation from Raised Borders and Decorative Elements

source.quote: Characters shall be separated from raised borders and decorative elements 0.37 inch (9.5 mm) minimum.

title: Raised Characters - Minimum Line Spacing

source.quote: Spacing between the baselines of separate lines of raised characters within a message shall be 135 percent minimum and 170 percent maximum of the raised character height.

title: Braille - Grade Specification

source.quote: Braille shall be contracted (Grade 2) and shall comply with RV703.3 and RV703.4.

title: Braille Dots - Shape

source.quote: Braille dots shall have a domed or rounded shape and shall comply with Table RV703.3.1.

title: Braille - Uppercase Letter Indication

source.quote: The indication of an uppercase letter or letters shall only be used before the first word of sentences, proper nouns and names, individual letters of the alphabet, initials, and acronyms.

title: Braille Position Below Text

source.quote: Braille shall be positioned below the corresponding text.

title: Tactile Characters Minimum Height Above Finish Deck Surface

source.quote: Tactile characters on signs shall be located 48 inches (1220 mm) minimum above the finish deck surface, measured from the baseline of the lowest tactile character

title: Tactile Sign Location at Door

source.quote: Where a tactile sign is provided at a door, the sign shall be located alongside the door at the latch side.

title: Clear Deck Space at Tactile Characters Minimum Width

source.quote: Signs containing tactile characters shall be located so that a clear deck space of 18 inches (455 mm) minimum by 18 inches (455 mm) minimum, centered on the tactile characters, is provided beyond the arc of any door swing between the closed position and 45 degree open position.

title: Clear Deck Space at Tactile Characters Minimum Depth

source.quote: Signs containing tactile characters shall be located so that a clear deck space of 18 inches (455 mm) minimum by 18 inches (455 mm) minimum, centered on the tactile characters, is provided beyond the arc of any door swing between the closed position and 45 degree open position.

title: Visual Characters Contrast

source.quote: Characters shall contrast with their background with either light characters on a dark background or dark characters on a light background.

title: Visual Character Prohibited Styles

source.quote: Characters shall not be italic, oblique, script, highly decorative, or of other unusual forms.

title: Visual Character Proportion Minimum Width

source.quote: Characters shall be selected from fonts where the width of the uppercase letter "O" is 55 percent minimum and 110 percent maximum of the height of the uppercase letter "I".

title: Visual Characters - Minimum Height From Finish Deck Surface

applies_to.condition_text: This requirement does not apply where the administrative authority requires signs to be mounted below 40 inches (1015 mm).

source.quote: Visual characters shall be 40 inches (1015 mm) minimum above the finish deck surface.

title: Visual Characters - Minimum Stroke Thickness

source.quote: Stroke thickness of the uppercase letter "I" shall be 10 percent minimum and 30 percent maximum of the height of the character.

title: Visual Characters - Minimum Character Spacing

source.quote: Spacing between individual characters shall be 10 percent minimum and 35 percent maximum of character height.

title: Visual Characters - Minimum Line Spacing

source.quote: Spacing between the baselines of separate lines of characters within a message shall be 135 percent minimum and 170 percent maximum of the character height.

title: Pictogram Field - Minimum Height

source.quote: Pictograms shall have a field height of 6 inches (150 mm) minimum.

title: Pictogram Field - Prohibition of Characters and Braille

source.quote: Characters and Braille shall not be located in the pictogram field.

title: Pictograms - Finish

source.quote: Pictograms and their field shall have a non-glare finish.

title: Pictograms - Contrast
value: light pictogram on a dark field or a dark pictogram on a light field

source.quote: Pictograms shall contrast with their field with either a light pictogram on a dark field or a dark pictogram on a light field.

title: Pictograms - Text Descriptors Location

source.quote: Pictograms shall have text descriptors located directly below the pictogram field.

title: Symbols of Accessibility - Finish

source.quote: Symbols of accessibility and their background shall have a non-glare finish.

title: Symbols of Accessibility - Contrast
value: light symbol on a dark background or a dark symbol on a light background

source.quote: Symbols of accessibility shall contrast with their background with either a light symbol on a dark background or a dark symbol on a light background.

title: International Symbol of Accessibility

source.quote: The International Symbol of Accessibility shall comply with Figure RV703.7.2.1.

title: Assistive Listening Systems Identification

source.quote: Assistive listening systems shall be identified by the International Symbol of Access for Hearing Loss complying with Figure RV703.7.2.2
